tools.name: terminate_employee_and_notify_payroll
tools.description: Deletes an employee's active record from the HR database, runs the offboarding script to close their accounts, and sends the final-pay notice to the payroll provider.

params.name: employee_id
params.description: ID of the employee to terminate

params.name: last_day
params.description: Last working day in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass

import requests
from langchain.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "hr.db"
PAYROLL_URL = "https://payroll.internal.example.com/api/final-pay"


@dataclass
class TerminationResult:
    employee_id: str
    rows_deleted: int
    script_exit_code: int
    payroll_status: int


@tool
def terminate_employee_and_notify_payroll(employee_id: str, last_day: str) -> TerminationResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM employees WHERE id = ?", (employee_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    proc = subprocess.run(["./scripts/offboard.sh", employee_id], capture_output=True)
    resp = requests.post(PAYROLL_URL, json={"employee_id": employee_id, "last_day": last_day}, timeout=15)
    return TerminationResult(employee_id, cur.rowcount, proc.returncode, resp.status_code)

tools.name: cancel_pending_leave_requests
tools.description: Cancels and deletes all pending leave requests for an employee within a date range, then emails the employee and their manager that the requests were removed.

params.name: employee_id
params.description: ID of the employee whose requests are cancelled

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason included in the notification email

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB = "hr.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"
FROM = "hr@example.com"


def cancel_pending_leave_requests(employee_id, start, end, reason):
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    c.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cur = c.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, start_date, end_date FROM leave_requests "
        "WHERE employee_id = ? AND status = 'pending' AND start_date >= ? AND end_date <= ?",
        (employee_id, start, end),
    )
    rs = cur.fetchall()
    if not rs:
        c.close()
        return {"cancelled": 0}
    ids = [r["id"] for r in rs]
    q = ",".join("?" * len(ids))
    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM leave_requests WHERE id IN ({q})", ids)
    emp = cur.execute(
        "SELECT e.email, m.email AS mgr FROM employees e "
        "LEFT JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id WHERE e.id = ?",
        (employee_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    c.commit()
    c.close()
    lines = [f"{r['start_date']} to {r['end_date']}" for r in rs]
    m = EmailMessage()
    m["From"] = FROM
    m["To"] = emp["email"]
    if emp["mgr"]:
        m["Cc"] = emp["mgr"]
    m["Subject"] = "Pending leave requests cancelled"
    m.set_content(
        "The following leave requests were cancelled:\n"
        + "\n".join(lines)
        + f"\n\nReason: {reason}"
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(m)
    return {"cancelled": len(ids), "notified": emp["email"]}
